preview.readOnly: Browser preview is read-only. Configure models in the macOS app.
preview.mcpReadOnly: Browser preview only; configure MCP in the macOS app.

status.partialModelReadFailed: Some model statuses could not be read. Recording and basic search are still available.

hints.llm: Ask questions, continue discussions, and organize ideas worth keeping.
hints.embedding: Find related memories even when you phrase the search differently.
hints.voice: Speak to capture an idea or ask a question.

model.offlineNotice: You can record, edit, and use basic search without connecting a model.
model.connectionLocalOnly: Connection details are stored only on this Mac

capability.voiceLocalDescription: Chinese, English, and more · about 1.02 GB
capability.voiceModelPlaceholder: For example, whisper-1 or a provider model ID
capability.savedKeyPlaceholder: Saved; leave empty to keep it
capability.emptyKeyPlaceholder: Can be empty for a local service
capability.serviceDescription: Enter an OpenAI-compatible service and model, then test the connection to enable it.
capability.localPrivacy: Content is processed on this Mac and is not sent to a model service.
capability.embeddingPrivacy: Creating the index sends current memory text; later additions, edits, and search questions (including related memories and MCP searches) are sent. The vector index stays on this Mac.
capability.voicePrivacy: Audio is sent in segments to the selected service while recording. You can edit the transcript; it is saved only after you submit.
capability.llmPrivacy: Questions, necessary conversation, and related memories are sent when used. Automatic organization also sends new records and relevant context.
capability.autoOrganizeDescription: Records saved while this is off keep their original text and are not organized when you turn it back on.
capability.fastResponse: Fast response (turns off model reasoning; the endpoint must support it)
capability.queryInstructionsDescription: Usually leave this empty. Models that require an instruction can follow their official format; it is added before the search question.
capability.canDisable: You can turn this off at any time; saved content is kept.

embedding.title: Semantic search
embedding.description: Make every search entry more meaning-aware, including multilingual and mixed Chinese-English queries. The model runs locally; Q&A still uses the generation model configured below.
embedding.modelDescription: About 640 MB to download, plus local space for the index. Models are shared at ~/Library/Caches/com.memivy.app/models/ across all Memivy libraries.

status.disabled: Off; model and index are kept

embedding.failedMemories_one: {{count}} memory failed to encode; it remains available to keyword search.
embedding.failedMemories_other: {{count}} memories failed to encode; they remain available to keyword search.
embedding.indexScope: Only current memories are processed. Archived items, history, trash, and unsaved drafts are not indexed.
embedding.confirmCurrent: This will process the current memories. You can still record, read, and use basic search while preparation runs.
embedding.confirmCount_one: This will process {{count}} current memory. You can still record, read, and use basic search while preparation runs.
embedding.confirmCount_other: This will process {{count}} current memories. You can still record, read, and use basic search while preparation runs.
embedding.localConfirm: Everything is processed on this Mac. Archived items, history, trash, and drafts are excluded.
embedding.remoteConfirm: Text excerpts will be sent to “{{service}}”; later additions and edits are processed incrementally and may incur provider charges. Archived items, history, trash, and drafts are excluded.
embedding.rebuildCurrent: The current memories will be processed again with the active model. A model service receives text excerpts and may charge for them; a local model processes them on this Mac. Basic search remains available and the text stays unchanged.
embedding.rebuildCount_one: The active model will process {{count}} current memory again. A model service receives text excerpts and may charge for them; a local model processes them on this Mac. Basic search remains available and the text stays unchanged.
embedding.rebuildCount_other: The active model will process {{count}} current memories again. A model service receives text excerpts and may charge for them; a local model processes them on this Mac. Basic search remains available and the text stays unchanged.

voice.title: Voice input
voice.description: Speak to capture an idea or ask a question.
voice.modelDescription: Chinese, English, and more · no API key required
voice.idleRelease: Releases runtime memory after 1 minute idle
voice.onDemandGpu: Loads on demand, preferring the GPU
voice.preloadMainDescription: Prepare the model when Memivy opens so the first recording starts sooner.
voice.preloadDescription: Loads on demand and releases runtime memory after 1 minute idle. Turning this off does not delete model files.
voice.shortcutDescription: Press once to open the quick entry and record; press again to stop.
voice.shortcutDescriptionShared: The main window and quick entry share the model and draft rules.
voice.tryDescription: After enabling it, click the microphone in a capture or question field to try it. Each recording can last up to 5 minutes; submit only after stopping and finishing transcription.
voice.footnote: Transcription is split at pauses. You can edit the text after stopping, then submit it yourself. Each recording can last up to 5 minutes.
voice.cacheDescription: Voice and semantic search share the Memivy model cache; development builds, installed builds, and libraries share the weights. Turning this off does not delete the model; if the cache is cleared, you can download it again.
voice.runtimeDescription: The GPU handles both audio encoding and text decoding; CPU is used when unavailable. New background vector-index batches pause during recording and transcription. Temporary recordings are cleared after submission or removal.

desktop.title: macOS quick entry
desktop.description: Capture an idea or continue the last topic at any time. The menu bar remains available after the main window closes; ⌘Q quits the app.
desktop.shortcutDescription: Press once to open and again to collapse. After setting it for the first time, switch to another app and try it once.
desktop.showAssistantHint: Drag it to a convenient spot
desktop.pauseEntryHint: Temporarily disable the shortcut and desktop assistant
desktop.foregroundPrivacy: The foreground app name is read only when you open the entry. You attach web links or file paths yourself; saving the original text does not depend on a model.

login.title: Start at login
login.description: Start quietly and keep the menu bar entry. Current: {{status}}.
login.notFoundHelp: Move the official Memivy app to the Applications folder before enabling start at login.

backup.title: Backup and restore
backup.description: Backups include memories, original captures, versions, discussions, drafts, and trash; model keys are excluded.
backup.createDescription: Save local content as a backup file.
backup.restoreDescription: Restore the entire library and automatically keep a copy from before the restore.
backup.verifiedSummary: Backup verified. It contains {{memories}} memories and {{captures}} original captures. After you confirm, the library will restart and restore everything; current content is first saved as a recoverable copy.
backup.settingsRetained: Model configuration and the MCP switch keep their current settings.

storage.title: Manage local model files
storage.description: Development builds, installed builds, and all libraries share model weights. Deleting a file does not delete memories; another library will need to download it again.
storage.deleteDialogDescription: This will free about {{size}} MB. Other Memivy libraries are affected and will need to download the model again.
storage.localModelDisabled: The capability using this local model will be turned off.
storage.serviceUnaffected: The capability using a model service is not affected.
storage.contentRetained: Memories, original captures, and drafts are kept.

mcp.title: External Agent · MCP
mcp.description: Allow an external Agent to save original text you explicitly ask it to remember and search a small set of saved memories. The Agent may send returned content to the model it uses. Search shares the semantic-search setting; after you select a model service, search questions are also sent to that service.
mcp.enabledNotice: MCP read and write access is allowed. Continue by configuring the connection in your external Agent.
mcp.disabledNotice: MCP is off; new tool calls will be rejected.
mcp.executableMissing: MCP program not found. Reinstall the complete app bundle; during development, run npm run build:mcp first.
mcp.connectionInstructions: Move Memivy to a fixed installation location before copying the configuration. Your external Agent must support local stdio; add the service as instructed and reconnect. Copy the configuration again after moving the app.
mcp.afterExit: Memivy can still save and search after it exits; automatic organization continues the next time the app opens with a model available. Turn off this switch to stop new MCP reads and writes.
mcp.diagnosticPassed_one: Local stdio check passed · v{{version}} · protocol {{protocol}} · {{count}} tool.
mcp.diagnosticPassed_other: Local stdio check passed · v{{version}} · protocol {{protocol}} · {{count}} tools.
mcp.diagnosticScope: This verifies only the local program and tool list; it does not confirm an external Agent connection.
mcp.diagnosticEnabled: Read and write access is currently allowed.
mcp.diagnosticDisabled: The switch is currently off, so data calls will still be rejected.
mcp.tryConnection: After connecting, try “Remember: this is my MCP test note”, then search for that sentence. Only a successful call confirms that the external Agent is connected.

searchMaintenance.title: Search maintenance
searchMaintenance.rebuildDescription: Generate it again from current memories without changing their text.
searchMaintenance.dialogDescription: Generate the index again from current memories; text and drafts stay unchanged.
